filter_note: V1 set (7) + market briefing + AI news; Today window = Tue Nov 3 – Wed Nov 4 PT

market_briefing.lede: Nooks put a $500M growth-capital commitment behind a proactive sales assistant and a full-lifecycle Revenue Agent Platform, while Salesforce priced Agentforce Coworker at $50 per user per month and pushed it into Teams, mobile, and desktop. Slack says half of messages now come from apps and agents, with MCP tool calls doubling quarter over quarter.

bullets.text: Nov 4: Nooks announced a $500 million commitment from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund (non-dilutive growth capital repaid from customer value), launched Node (AI personal assistant for sales; early access now, GA early 2027), and framed the Nooks Revenue Agent Platform with Deal, Outbound, Expansion and Coaching Agents live and Inbound Agents due Q1 2027. Company claims 2,000+ customers, ~3× YoY growth and 135% NRR.

Nov 4: Salesforce said Agentforce Coworker usage hit more than 185,000 users (21× in three months) and added a $50 per-user, per-month SKU, reusable Skills, Conversation History, Google Workspace and Microsoft 365 connections; Teams, iOS, and Mac/Windows apps are generally available in November 2026.

Nov 3: Slack (Salesforce newsroom) reported that 50% of Slack messages are from apps and agents, with 127 million MCP tool calls per week (doubling QoQ) and 1.9 million weekly users interacting with third-party agents.

biggest_ai_news.title: OpenAI shows GPT-6 Astra designing physical hardware and expands Mazda / Chip Ganassi engineering work
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 3: two employees used Astra to design a Codex-connected device (enclosure, PCB, firmware) in under a week; a contract manufacturer built a small prototype batch in under a month, with manufacturing-tolerance gaps still needing human review. OpenAI also expanded Chip Ganassi Racing CAD-from-scan workflows and announced a Mazda research collaboration on aerodynamics and crash safety.

biggest_ai_news.title: Slack: half of messages are from apps and agents; 127M MCP tool calls/week
biggest_ai_news.body: Nov 3: Salesforce published Slack-by-the-numbers as agents move into production channels via MCP; Slackbot called the fastest-adopted AI product in Salesforce history.

what_changed.title: Nooks: $500M GC CVF + Node + Revenue Agent Platform
what_changed.body: NEW. Nov 4 company blog and PR: General Catalyst Customer Value Fund commits $500M growth capital (not a conventional equity round; repaid from customer value created). Node is positioned as a proactive "EA for the AE" (deal management first; reps approve sends; early access now, GA early 2027). Platform agents: Deal, Outbound, Expansion, Coaching now; Inbound Q1 2027. Metrics claimed: 2,000+ companies, ~3× YoY growth, 135% NRR, 96% of agent emails sent without edits, early Node users up to 80% higher productivity / ~2 hours saved per day (methodology not detailed).

what_changed.title: Salesforce expands Agentforce Coworker: 185k users, $50/user/mo, Teams + mobile/desktop
what_changed.body: NEW. Nov 4 newsroom: 21× usage growth in three months; new Skills, Conversation History, Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 connectivity; $50 per-user per-month SKU available now. GA in November 2026: Coworker in Microsoft Teams, iOS app, Mac/Windows desktop apps, Coworker MCP server, Flex Credits free trial. December expected: Daily Digest, scheduled tasks, industry-cloud mobile apps. Named customers/use cases: Fulton Bank, Adecco Group, BACA Systems. Salesforce+ "Meet your new coworker" demos also run today.

what_changed.title: Gong names Chief R&D Officer and CISO
what_changed.body: NEW (org). Nov 4 press: Liron Shtraichman (ex-monday.com engineering lead) as Chief R&D Officer to expand agentic capabilities across Revenue Graph / Harness / Operating Surfaces; Guy Havusha (ex-VP Platform Security at Gong; formerly monday.com Global CISO) as CISO.

what_changed.title: Slack publishes agent-era usage stats
what_changed.body: NEW (adjacent). Nov 3: 50% of messages from apps/agents; 127M weekly MCP tool calls; 1.9M weekly users of third-party agents; Slackbot fastest-adopted AI product in Salesforce history.

quiet_note: No new product launches, pricing or M&A from Clay, Outreach or Monaco in the Nov 3–4 window. Salesloft's Behind Every Win virtual summit is live today 11 AM–1 PM ET (8–10 AM PT); as of the morning cutoff no new GA, pricing or Agentic Playbook update beyond the Oct 27 early-access announcement had posted to the newsroom. interpretation.fact: On Nov 4 Nooks announced a $500M General Catalyst CVF commitment, Node (early access; GA early 2027), and the Revenue Agent Platform. Salesforce announced Agentforce Coworker at >185k users with a new $50/user/mo SKU and Teams/mobile/desktop expansion. Gong appointed a Chief R&D Officer and CISO. Slack (Nov 3) said 50% of messages are from apps/agents and reported 127M weekly MCP tool calls. OpenAI (Nov 3) published physical-engineering demos with Astra and Mazda/CGR collaborations. Salesloft's Nov 4 summit was underway at morning cutoff with no new newsroom product/pricing post found beyond Oct 27 early access.
interpretation.note: Interpretation: Nooks is betting that a proactive deal assistant plus owned dialing/sending infrastructure — funded by outcome-tied growth capital — can take share from sequencing suites. Salesforce is packaging the "one teammate that orchestrates many agents" story with predictable per-seat price, which makes budget conversations easier than Flex-only metering. Slack's stats support the thesis that agent work is consolidating where humans already collaborate.

feed.summary: Salesforce said Agentforce Coworker ran nearly 6 million queries in September, up 21× in three months, as it expanded Coworker surfaces and packaging.
Nooks said General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund committed $500M in growth capital and pointed to its Node / Revenue Agent Platform push.
